name: ask-an-older-guy
description: Life-advice tool drawing on 101 recorded interviews with men over 40, covering health, love, money, career, and starting over.

com.openai.interface.longDescription: Ask an Older Guy draws on 101 recorded interviews with men over 40 to answer real questions about health, love, money, career, and feeling stuck or alone in your 20s and 30s. Every answer includes a named pattern, a directly attributed quote, and one concrete action you can take tonight.
capabilities: Answers real-life questions using 101 recorded interviews
Covers health, love, money, career, and starting over
Lists all topics covered on request
com.openai.interface.defaultPrompt: I feel stuck and don't know what to do about my career.
